title: Gemini Flash-lite kept reliably available
summary:
A garden-maintenance day: reliable Gemini access, refreshed community signals, and one carefully standardized audio-model separator.

Gemini 2.5 Flash-lite routing was adjusted and then restored after quota limits appeared, keeping access to the model uninterrupted while the multi-project GCP setup evolves.

The daily automation updated app health and greenhouse metrics alongside the README's latest news and recent-app highlights, so the public map of the ecosystem stays current.

ACE-Step's description now uses the same separator style as the rest of the audio registry. Software remains extremely particular about commas.
